intro.title: Redesigning OUI.sncf with digital sobriety as a requirement
paragraphs: SNCF Connect & Tech led the redesign of the OUI.sncf app, used by millions of people to book train tickets.
The project had significant business stakes, with a clear ambition for sobriety and ecodesign from the design phase.
The goal was to improve the user experience while reducing the environmental impact of application journeys, especially on the TER booking journey.

image.alt: SNCF Connect & Tech client case illustration on digital sobriety of the booking application

results.title: −19% CO₂ and a journey 8 seconds faster
items: 19% less CO₂ on the TER booking journey.
300 KB fewer requests per booking, approximately 9 TB per year.
Two applications certified Silver level, for Android and iOS.

items.title: An audit before go-live
items.text: The application was audited before go-live to identify the main improvement levers.

items.title: Concrete improvement areas
items.text: Several optimisation paths were identified, especially on geolocation and data loading.

items.title: Implementation by the project team
items.text: Recommendations were taken on board by the project team, then followed up with a new measurement to verify the gains achieved.

items.title: An approach integrated throughout the project
items.text: Performance control and digital sobriety were integrated into requirements from the design phase and throughout the project.

testimonial.title: Sébastien Gobin speaks
quotes: « From the design phase and throughout the project, we integrated performance control linked to a sobriety approach into our requirements. With Greenspector, we were able to add measurement, work on optimisations while continuing to raise awareness among our teams on the subject, for a very encouraging result. »
